name: Photoresistor (LDR)
description: A light-dependent resistor (GL5528): about 10 kΩ at 10 lux (a dim room), a few hundred ohms in bright light and about 1 MΩ in the dark. It has no polarity. Make a voltage divider with a 10kΩ resistor and read the middle with analogRead(). Select it and drag the Light slider while the simulation runs (0 = dark, 300 = indoor light, 1000 = overcast daylight).
